title: Fixed-presentation realization of the completed open exchange square
statement: For a Cartesian open square of finite-type schemes over the fixed finite-field closure, take fixed Open data od,odprime [def-sf-open-factor-fixed-data] and the strict completed exchange conclusion [lem-sf-open-exchange-roos-restriction]. There exist normalized fixed Pull data for h and a, an ordinary exchange normalized by its inverse open-unit transpose, and an ambient completed pullback square. The completed square carries the actual pullback units to one another. Restriction of beta, defined from these fixed comparisons, is this square followed by pullback of the section-normalized open restriction. For constructible K, precomposition with the actual horizontal pull-completion unit into the completed extended target is injective. No tensor or projection assertion is included. The signatures also use [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-sf-pull-completion-comparison], [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-cbc-open-immersion-square], [def-sf-completed-open-strict-mate-data], [def-a1-integral-completed-pullback-interfaces].

proof.text: The coefficient projection equations identify the fixed strict quotient pullbacks with the completed-exchange presentation. Descend the same tower maps to fixed Pull data, retaining the pure-tensor generator equation and representative model. The ordinary finite inverse-unit transpose gives OrdinaryExchange, with theta the specified ordinary compositor.

The ordered strict derived-limit exchange is exactly beta after these comparisons. Restriction commutes with the same augmented quotient systems on ambient inputs, giving completedSquare and square_unit; the restricted finite open mate and the identity restricted Roos comparison give beta_restriction.

The extended target is complete. The actual quotient-unit reflector property gives injectivity of precomposition with that unit. Transport across the fixed horizontal comparison to obtain the displayed injectivity for beta_unique.

lean.statement:
theorem openFactorExchangeRealization
    (F : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ F.p)
    (U' U X' X : Over (Spec (.of F.k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType U'.hom] [QuasiCompact U'.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom] [QuasiCompact U.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X'.hom] [QuasiCompact X'.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom]
    (a : U' ⟶ U) (j' : U' ⟶ X') (j : U ⟶ X) (h : X' ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j.left] [IsOpenImmersion j'.left]
    (sq : OpenImmersionSquare a.left j'.left j.left h.left)
    (od : Open l E j.left) (od' : Open l E j'.left)
    (hb : OpenExchangeRoos.Assertion l E a.left j'.left j.left h.left
      (qc := OpenExchangeRoos.finiteOpenQC F U X j) sq) :
    ∃ (oh : Pull l E h.left) (oa : Pull l E a.left) (b : OrdinaryExchange l E sq)
      (r : integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E h.left ⋙ star l E j'.left ≅
        star l E j.left ⋙ integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E a.left),
      (∀ K : D l E X.left,
        (star l E j'.left).map ((oh.unit l E).app K) ≫ r.hom.app K =
          (theta l E sq).hom.app K ≫ (oa.unit l E).app ((star l E j.left).obj K)) ∧
      (∀ K : D l E U.left, sfIntegralConstructible l E U.left K →
        (star l E j'.left).map (beta l E b oh oa od' K) ≫
            od'.restrictionIso.hom.app ((integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E a.left).obj K) =
          r.hom.app ((J l E j.left).obj K) ≫
            (integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E a.left).map (od.restrictionIso.hom.app K)) ∧
      (∀ K : D l E U.left, sfIntegralConstructible l E U.left K →
        Function.Injective
          (fun v : (integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E h.left).obj
              ((J l E j.left).obj K) ⟶
              (J l E j'.left).obj ((integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E a.left).obj K) ↦
            (oh.unit l E).app ((J l E j.left).obj K) ≫ v))
